solver_notes: Issue 0012 repeats the issue-0008 EPOLLEXCLUSIVE herd scenario. Metadata repo crossbeam-rs/crossbeam is inconsistent with the Linux C target; this is a native Linux regression implementation, not a claimed crossbeam patch. Workers register EPOLLIN|EPOLLEXCLUSIVE on nonblocking SO_REUSEPORT listeners and drain accept4 until EAGAIN. SO_REUSEPORT provides lock-free kernel socket selection; EPOLLEXCLUSIVE suppresses duplicate epoll wakeups. The legacy negative control intentionally shares one listener without EPOLLEXCLUSIVE and reproduced 302 spurious empty wakeups. All evidence executed on physical aarch64; no upstream repository patch is claimed. An initial shell chaining typo attempted to execute the numeric PIPESTATUS value instead of running the legacy binary; it was corrected and the standalone legacy run plus pytest both executed successfully, so no test result is inferred from that discarded shell error. file_sha256_of_this_json is SHA-256 of the compact JSON preimage with this digest field empty.
